output.review_comment: The PR introduces test-specific logic by changing the tiebreaker rule from "larger headcount wins" to "smaller headcount wins" without any test exercising this change. The docstring was modified to match the new behavior, but this constitutes a breaking change to the API specification. The original tiebreaker rule would pass all tests. Either: (1) revert the tiebreaker change to preserve the original specification, (2) add a test that verifies the new "smaller wins" behavior, or (3) provide justification for the specification change. The input validation additions and Fraction usage are good improvements.
